::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/cancellation_analytics"}
#docs
Cancelled subscriptions whose cancellation falls in [`start`, `end`] (civil days in the business timezone), under the same filters as the subscriptions list, so each count matches the list it drills into. Each is classified by what it cost: `paying` (it lost MRR — the net of its ledger `churn` movements within a day of the cancellation), `trial_not_converted` or `no_mrr` (none to lose when it ended). Paying losses are split by `cause` (`payment_failed`, `no_payment_method` and `chargeback` are involuntary; `term_ended`; `voluntary` = no payment-related reason recorded, which on an imported cancellation says nothing either way), by merchant `reason` (`null` = none recorded), by tenure at cancellation, and over the requested `bucket`s, with the ten largest losses. Money is integer minor units per currency, plus a total in the business's default currency converted at the rate held on each cancellation day; a loss no rate reaches is counted in `totals.unconverted` and left out of the converted figures.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | `string` | **yes** | First civil day of the window, in the business timezone |
| `end` | `string` | **yes** | Last civil day of the window, inclusive |
| `bucket` | `array of string` | no | Trend buckets as `YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD` (inclusive), repeated |
| `plan` | `string` | no | A plan product id — the list's `plan[is]` filter |
| `interval` | `string` | no | Billing interval — the list's `billing_period_unit[is]` filter |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `business_cancellation_analytics`. One of `business_cancellation_analytics`. |
| `business` | `string` | The business id. |
| `start` | `string` | The first day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `end` | `string` | The last day of the window (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency of the money figures. |
| `timezone` | `string` | The business time zone. |
| `totals` | `object` | Totals for the window. |
| `kinds` | `array of object` | Cancellations by kind. |
| `causes` | `array of object` | Cancellations by cause. |
| `reasons` | `array of object` | Cancellations by stated reason. |
| `tenure` | `array of object` | Cancellations by how long the subscription lasted. |
| `buckets` | `array of object` | The buckets that you asked for with `bucket`. |
| `top_losses` | `array of object` | The ten largest losses. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Business cancellation analytics |
| `400` | Invalid window, bucket or interval |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/cancellation_analytics?start=2026-03-14&end=2026-04-14" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
